output.summary: The denial is due to the out‑of‑network status without an emergency attestation. Collect and submit the required emergency attestation and discharge summary before pursuing further review.

items.text: Obtain the emergency attestation confirming the MRI was performed as an emergency service.
Provide the discharge summary to document medical necessity and any emergency context.
Contact the provider to request the missing emergency attestation and discharge summary, and submit them to the claims department within the next 5 business days.
The claim is flagged with the EMERGENCY_REQUIRED gate, so no appeal basis exists until the required emergency evidence is submitted.
